title: feat(ui): one server-status chip with a per-service restart panel
context:
Ships the frontend for the /api/system/services endpoint that went out in
v5.17.0 without it. The release staged server.py and not static/, so the
backend has been live with nothing rendering it.

One STATUS chip in the sidebar header replaces the separate WatchTower and
Worker badges, rolling the dashboard, worker and queue server into a single
red/yellow/green verdict. Clicking it opens a rebuilt System status panel:
per-service start time, pid/version/port, what a restart would cost right
now
decision: Introduced static/app.js, static/tour.js, tests/test_system_services.py, tests/test_worker_badge_copy.py: added _fetchSystemServices, _sysServiceMap, relDuration, absStamp, formatStarted, _plural, sysDashBusySentence, sysWorkerBusySentence; changed sysOpenModal, sysCloseModal.
